title: RWB-S7-E6025-APP: the closure slice has no plan row for its five consumed contracts, its rule kit, its event library, its scheduler marker, the retention period, the placement record or the closing amounts
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6025-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-025; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.3, A2.13 and Requirements served; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.3, T4, T5.2, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-36, R-WO-47 and R-WO-48; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-24; Batch and Scheduling Design v4 JOB-16; Business Requirements Program v4 REQ-S7-008, NFR-028, NFR-030 and NFR-031; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-13
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6025-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case state, answers two case moves, reads and stops the case timers, reads the placement of PLACED_WITH_AGENCY and reads the WO package on rwb-decision, so five consumed rows have no plan row. (2) DP-10 is absent from the pattern set although both rules name the Workbench scheduler, and R-WO-47 stops every timer; no JOB row of the service covers the retention wait. (3) DP-04 is absent although R-WO-36, R-WO-47 and R-WO-48 are evaluated from the WO route set of 51 rules over 27 states, so no Drools kit row RWB-PLT-E1072-CON or C row RWB-P7-E1073-CON is held. (4) DP-09 is absent although the service owns the topic rwb.writeoff.events.v1 and event EV-24 WriteOffApproved, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (5) The retention period has no value in any source: NFR-028, NFR-030 and NFR-031 are open under DL26 and REQ-S7-008 names the period without a length, and no source gives its reference-data home under DP-06 or DP-07. (6) The placement of PLACED_WITH_AGENCY, its ends_at and its recovered_amount have no column in write_off, no field ID and no published owner operation, and the connection matrix gives S7 no row to rwb-partner (S9) although the legacy Data table lists the partner row. (7) R-WO-47 asks for a closing entry with cash recovered and loss; no column of write_off carries a loss, recovered_after is the only recovered amount field and no source binds either amount to it. (8) The legacy Data table lists recovery_case, timer, partner, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which is this service's, and the timer stop has no published operation. (9) TSD S7 T4 prints 25 of the 51 rule rows and prints neither R-WO-36, R-WO-47 nor R-WO-48, so the two rules and the two state values come from the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 and FSD S7 A2.13 only. (10) FSD S7 A2.13.3.3 gives no primary person because the step runs unattended, while the legacy story is written as the Credit Administration officer.
evidence: Split plan slice RWB-S7-E6025-APP: C, I and X empty and reqs empty before this WP; context pack S7 ownership rows (one table write_off, two POST operations, one event EV-24, one job JOB-16, one workflow WriteOffWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S7 (Temporal to P7, Temporal and events to P8, REST and events to P1, no row to S9); TSD S7 T3.1 field list DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 and T4 with 25 printed rows; TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 only; FSD S7 A2.13.3.1 rows VR-S7-013-1, R-WO-36, R-WO-47 and BR-S7-013 and A2.13.3.3 roles None and Credit Administration officer; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-36, R-WO-47 and R-WO-48; Business Requirements Program v4 NFR-028, NFR-030 and NFR-031 marked Open under DL26; legacy RWB-E6-025 Data table and Screen table
area: Dependency, ownership, interface, reference data and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the rwb-case and rwb-decision rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; record RWB-PLT-E1072-CON, RWB-P7-E1073-CON and RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as tracked dependencies rather than metadata rows; read the Workbench scheduler marker as the durable timer of the workflow; publish the retention period and the retention classes as versioned reference data with a placeholder until Compliance sets them under DL26; agree the placement read with its owner and with rwb-case; carry cash recovered and loss as attributes of the closing entry; and record the unattended primary actor beside the legacy Credit Administration officer role

title: RWB-S7-E6025-CON: the consumed operation names, the placement element, the retention period and class, the closing amounts and the two unprinted rule rows have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6025-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-025; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.13.2, A2.13.3.1, A2.13.3.3, A2.13.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.3, T4, T5.2, T6.1 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-36, R-WO-47 and R-WO-48; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 /write-off-scans and /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision; Business Requirements Program v4 NFR-028, NFR-030 and NFR-031
description: (1) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, that reads or stops a timer or that reads a placement, so four consumed rows carry placeholders. (2) The timer table of DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036 is named in the legacy Data table but is not this service's and its element is not published. (3) The WO rule package read has no published operation name and DP-04 is not in the pattern set, while R-WO-36, R-WO-47 and R-WO-48 are all rows TSD S7 T4 does not print. (4) The placement and the partner row of DF-PRT-001 to DF-PRT-007 belong to another owner and no source publishes the read, and the connection matrix gives S7 no row to rwb-partner (S9). (5) The retention period and the retention classes have no value and no reference-data home: NFR-028, NFR-030 and NFR-031 are open under DL26. (6) The closing entry of R-WO-47 names cash recovered and loss, and no column of write_off, no field ID and no published element carries either amount. (7) The OpenAPI document of this key declares no operation for the closure step, so the contract declares an element and consumed rows and no provided surface, and the closure read behind SCR-27 is unpublished. (8) write_off.decision_log_id names the P7 decision_log_entry while DP-03 keeps the record locally. (9) TSD S7 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set.
evidence: TSD S7 T4 (51 rules over 27 states and 25 rows printed, none of them R-WO-36, R-WO-47 or R-WO-48); TSD S7 T3.1 field list DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 and T3.3 relationships; TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; legacy RWB-E6-025 Data table entities recovery_case, timer, partner, decision_log_entry and rule_row and Endpoints table with the two POST rows; FSD S7 A2.13.3.1 rows R-WO-36 and R-WO-47 and A2.13.3.3 roles None and Credit Administration officer; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-36, R-WO-47 and R-WO-48; API Specification v4 WriteOff element with five required properties; Business Requirements Program v4 NFR-028, NFR-030 and NFR-031 marked Open under DL26
area: Contract surface, interface names and reference data
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the case boundary as the child workflow's input, signals and stage outcome, publish the timer and placement elements with their owners, publish the two closure state values against the enumeration RWB-S7-E6017-CON already declares, publish the closing-entry element with cash recovered and loss, settle the retention period and the class list as versioned reference data, and confirm the operation names with the rwb-case and rwb-decision owners before the baseline is tagged
